name: Polygon PoS MRC20 unbacked native issuance
summary: The genesis MRC20 runtime accepted an invalid zero-address authorization without enforcing the source balance, causing five unbacked native MATIC issuances before the emergency runtime replacement.
notes: MRC20 is block-zero system code with no deployment transaction. Its vulnerable genesis runtime remained byte-identical through the incident and was replaced only at the later emergency hardfork.

Gross loss is the five unbacked native-balance issuances recorded by MRC20 Transfer events from the zero address: 10,000 + 50,000 + 540,000 + 100,300.509906 + 101,301.009906 = 801,601.519812 MATIC. Each amount exactly equals the recipient's archive native-balance increase across its receipt block. These are protocol-created native units, not inventory outflows or later disposal proceeds. Component-specific prices are the closest preceding DefiLlama observations. The separately disclosed 500,000-MATIC Whitehat2 bounty and Polygon's later reimbursement are not part of the blackhat receipt boundary and are not netted.
MRC20 is genesis system code, so deployment is represented by chain state at block zero rather than a fabricated deployment transaction.
